content.short: CreatorDAO provides a p2P investing marketplace where creators invest in each other and get paid by CreatorDAO.
content.description: CreatorDAO leverages Web3 tools to connect creators of every level, from seasoned artists to upstart YouTubers. By enabling peer-to-peer crypto investments, it allows creators to invest in one another and grow together. The platform also connects supporters with new creators, making it easier to discover emerging talent and provide support as they develop. Through these connections, CreatorDAO seeks to support the development of creators and the broader community.
